name: Cohere
look: Monumental display on white editorial canvases, interrupted by deep green and dark navy bands, with near-black pill CTAs.

hero.title: AI built for the enterprise
hero.sub: Retrieval, reranking and generation that run inside your own cloud, grounded in your documents, with citations on every answer.

features.title: Grounded, not guessing
features.sub: Retrieval-augmented generation with the retrieval done properly, because that is where accuracy actually comes from.

items.title: Retrieval
items.body: Semantic search across your corpus, tuned for enterprise documents rather than web pages.

items.title: Reranking
items.body: A dedicated rerank model that reorders candidates by relevance — the cheapest accuracy you can buy.

items.title: Citations
items.body: Every generated claim points at the passage it came from, so a reviewer can check it.

items.title: In your VPC
items.body: Deploy the whole stack inside your own cloud account. Nothing leaves your perimeter.

items.title: 100+ languages
items.body: Multilingual embeddings that put a French query and an English document in the same space.

items.title: Connectors
items.body: Your wiki, your drive, your ticketing system — indexed and kept current.

showcases.title: Accuracy comes from the retrieval step
showcases.body: Most failures blamed on the model are retrieval failures. A dedicated rerank pass over a wide candidate set fixes more errors, more cheaply, than moving to a larger generator does.
points: Rerank over a wide candidate set
Measured on your own corpus, not a public benchmark

showcases.title: Inside your perimeter
showcases.body: The full stack runs in your own VPC on AWS, Azure, GCP or bare metal. No data egress, no shared tenancy, and the same models as the hosted service.

gallery.title: Research
gallery.sub: Papers, model cards and evaluation methodology.

testimonial.quote: The citations were the thing that got it past legal. Not accuracy claims — the fact that every sentence points at a paragraph somebody can go and read.
testimonial.name: Ingrid Solberg

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.sub: Per token on the hosted API, per node in your own cloud.

items.q: Why does reranking matter so much?
items.a: Because most wrong answers come from retrieving the wrong passage, not from the generator. Reranking a wide candidate set fixes more errors per pound than upgrading the generator.

items.q: Can it run without internet access?
items.a: Yes. Air-gapped deployments are supported, with model updates delivered as signed artefacts you install on your own schedule.

items.q: Do you train on our data?
items.a: No. Enterprise data is never used for training, and in a VPC deployment we have no access to it at all.
The generator is constrained to attribute each claim to a retrieved span. Answers it cannot ground are returned as an explicit inability rather than an unattributed guess.

cta.title: Build on your own documents
cta.sub: Start on the hosted API, move into your VPC when you are ready.

footer.tagline: Enterprise AI that runs where your data lives.

notes: Monumental display headlines with very tight line-height and negative tracking set the tone.
White editorial canvases are interrupted by deep green and dark navy bands — the interruption is the rhythm.
Pill CTAs in near-black or white; most secondary actions are underlined text links rather than buttons.
Trust-logo strips are monochrome with very wide vertical spacing around them.
Product mockups are dark agent-console panels with small status chips, not abstract illustration.
